description: In scripts/run_live_production_goal.py, around line 125, the 'target_agent' is hardcoded to 'GEMINI' for newly derived tasks. Modify it to intelligently select target_agent='CODEX' if the derived steps mention 'Mac', 'local', 'python', 'script', or 'code', target_agent='WINDOWS' if they mention 'Windows', 'PowerShell', or 'remote', and otherwise default to 'GEMINI'.
